'''Rubén Santiago Garcés Riquelme''' (born October 17, 1973) is a Panamanian professional [[basketball]] player. He last played for the [[Mets de Guaynabo (basketball)|Mets de Guaynabo]] of Puerto Rico.<ref>[http://basketball.latinbasket.com/player/Ruben_Garces/Mets_de_Guaynabo/11629 Latin Basket profile]</ref> A 6'9" [[Power forward (basketball)|power forward]]/[[center (basketball)|center]], he played [[United States|US]] [[college basketball]] with [[Navarro College|Navarro Junior College]] in [[Texas]], and with [[Providence College]] in [[Rhode Island]], and had a brief career in the [[National Basketball Association|NBA]] in the [[2000–01 NBA season|2000-01 season]], playing with [[Phoenix Suns|Phoenix]] and [[Golden State Warriors|Golden State]]. He has also played in the American [[Continental Basketball Association|CBA]], the [[Spain|Spanish]] [[Asociación de Clubs de Baloncesto|ACB]], in [[Argentina]], [[Venezuela]], and [[France]].<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20080205103243/http://www.fiba.com/pages/eng/fe/06_wcm/teamPlay/play/p/competitioncode/eventid/3507/langlc/en/playernumber/39960/roundid/3507/season/teamnumber/87/fe_teamPlay_playProf.html 2006 FIBA World Championship - Ruben Garces Player Profile]</ref>
